battle.name: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗
battle.theater: 喀布爾盆地與興都庫什山區
battle.brief: 一九七九年十二月二十四日，蘇聯空降兵同時奪下巴格蘭、喀布爾、坎大哈與賈拉勒阿巴德機場，二十七日進軍首都，二十八日暗殺總統阿明；一九八九年二月十五日，蘇聯兵最後離境。卡面這艘一八六二年英國鐵甲艦早已解甲，但裝甲的血統留在海上：蘇聯太平洋艦隊的裝甲航母，正是同一條線的末端。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方，表面是蘇聯與阿富汗民主共和國，實際打的是蘇聯紅軍同阿富汗游擊隊之間長達九年零兩個月的消耗。蘇聯一方以中亞軍區第40集團軍為骨幹，先後投入第8近衛聯合軍、第104空降師、第76近衛空突師與第108摩托化步兵師，兵力峰值約十一萬五千人，統一編為「駐阿富汗蘇軍集群」，後方由國防部、總參謀部與國安委員會遙控；同期太平洋艦隊在印度洋與阿拉伯海維持存在，監視美軍第七艦隊的航母戰鬥群，控制波斯灣入口，使南亞的港口航線始終在蘇聯視線之內。阿富汗一方是人民軍六個軍與民兵：駐喀布爾的第5軍、駐坎大哈的第2軍、駐赫拉特的第3軍、駐馬扎里沙里夫的第4軍、駐賈拉勒阿巴德的第6與第7軍，加上國安人民特工總局掌握的武裝；坦克、飛機與重砲全靠蘇聯供應，軍火多經土耳其與阿曼方向的海運補給線運抵。游擊隊一方以「白沙瓦七派」為骨幹，人數最多時超過三十萬，在巴基斯坦與伊朗境內屯集，經費與武器來自巴基斯坦情報局、美國中央情報局與沙烏地阿拉伯，親蘇與親美的武裝在同一片營地裡分開廝殺。巴基斯坦在官方上不承認參戰，卻以情報局為游擊隊提供訓練、情報與後勤，伊朗承辦了部分流亡派的營地，中國向喀布爾當局提供軍火與顧問。聯合國、伊斯蘭會議組織與歐洲各國在外交上譴責蘇聯出兵。
countriesEn: On paper the belligerents in this war were the Soviet Union and the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan, but what was actually fought was a grinding contest of nine years and two months between the Soviet army and the Afghan mujahideen. On the Soviet side the backbone was the 40th Army of the Turkestan Military District, into which were fed in turn the 8th Guards Combined Arms Army, the 104th Airborne Division, the 76th Guards Air Assault Division and the 108th Motor Rifle Division; the peak strength was about one hundred and fifteen thousand men, all of it formed into the Group of Soviet Forces in Afghanistan, with the Ministry of Defence, the General Staff and the Security Council pulling the strings from Moscow. At the same time the Pacific Fleet maintained a presence in the Indian Ocean and the Arabian Sea, watching the carrier task forces of the American 7th Fleet and holding the entrance to the Persian Gulf, so that the shipping lanes of South Asia stayed permanently in Soviet eyes. On the Afghan side stood the six army corps of the national army together with the militia: the 5th Corps at Kabul, the 2nd at Kandahar, the 3rd at Herat, the 4th at Mazar-i-Sharif, and the 6th and 7th at Jalalabad, plus the formations held by the State Security Service, KHAD. Every tank, aircraft and heavy gun came from the Soviets, with the ammunition moved in over the maritime supply route through Turkey and Oman. The mujahideen side was built around the Peshawar Seven, at times numbering more than three hundred thousand men, billeted across Pakistan and Iran, paid and equipped by the Pakistani intelligence service, the American Central Intelligence Agency and Saudi Arabia, with pro-Soviet and pro-American formations fighting each other inside the same camps. Pakistan never admitted to taking part officially, yet its intelligence service supplied the mujahideen with training, intelligence and logistics; Iran hosted the camps of some of the exile factions, and China provided arms and advisers to the government in Kabul. The United Nations, the Islamic Conference and the European states condemned the Soviet intervention diplomatically.
people: 開戰的決定在莫斯科作出：總書記布里茲涅夫批准出兵，國安委員會主席安德羅波夫是最堅定的推手，國防部長烏斯季諾夫用最短時間完成部隊與空運準備，總參謀長奧加爾科夫以兵力和後勤不足為由反對，最後被調離崗位。真正策劃十二月二十四日空降突擊的是國安部的將校，該部要員列昂尼德·切爾內赫當時正在喀布爾，後來正是他代表蘇聯在日內瓦議定書上簽字。十二月二十八日潛入總統府的特勤人員暗殺總統哈菲茲拉·阿明，喀布爾的電台當日換上新聲音。阿明這一邊的人馬包括肖爾革命後掌權的塔拉基派、總理努爾·穆罕默德·卡利卡尼，以及一九八〇年四月出任總統的巴布拉克·卡爾邁爾；詩人兼外交部長費茲·艾哈邁德·費茲在一九七八年四月的清洗中被處決，四軍旅長阿克蘭·亞里在政變當日身亡，國安人民特工總局的情報處在八十年代中期由穆罕默德·納吉布拉主持，他在一九九二年成了總統。游擊隊一方的要角是赫克馬蒂亞爾與阿卜杜勒·拉蘇勒·賽亞夫，前者率領古爾布丁派，後者在伊朗境內組織伊斯蘭團結派，另有當時只是基層指揮官的穆拉·奧馬爾。巴基斯坦方面，總統齊亞與情報局局長阿克塔爾·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼是最關鍵的推手；美國方面，總統卡特與國安顧問布熱津斯基決定了以情報機關而非正規軍出資援助游擊隊的方針。
peopleEn: The decision to open the war was taken in Moscow: the General Secretary Leonid Brezhnev authorised the intervention, the Security Council chairman Yuri Andropov was its firmest advocate, the Minister of Defence Dmitry Ustinov put the troops and the airlift together faster than anyone had expected, and the Chief of the General Staff Nikolai Ogarkov opposed it on the grounds that the troops and the logistics were insufficient, and was moved out of his post in the end. The plan for the airborne seizure of 24 December was worked out by the officers of the security service, and one of its principals, Leonid Chernykh, was in Kabul at the time; he was later the man who signed the Geneva Accords on behalf of the Soviet Union. On 28 December a special unit entered the presidential palace and shot President Hafizullah Amin, and the Kabul radio changed its voice the same day. On Amin's side stood the Taraki faction that had taken power after the Saur Revolution, Prime Minister Nur Muhammad Kalakani, and Babrak Karmal, who became president in April 1980. The poet and foreign minister Faiz Ahmad Faiz was executed in the purge of April 1978, the 4th Corps commander Akram Yari was killed on the day of the coup itself, and the intelligence section of the State Security Service was run in the mid-1980s by Mohammad Najibullah, who became president in 1992. On the mujahideen side the names that matter are Gulbuddin Hekmatyar, who led the Gulbuddin faction, and Abdul Rasul Sayyaf, who organised the Islamic Unity movement from Iran, together with Mullah Omar, at that time still a low-ranking commander. On the Pakistani side the key movers were President Zia and the director of the intelligence service, Akhtar Abdur Rahman; on the American side President Carter and the national security adviser Zbigniew Brzezinski settled on the policy of funding the mujahideen through the intelligence services rather than through the regular armed forces.
kits: 卡面這艘一八六二年英國鐵甲艦是一條血統的起點：木殼外面包了鐵，裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。本役的兵器離它有一百一十七年，但它留下的公式仍在運作——用裝甲承受火力，用速度決定位置，用大威力砲塔打擊對手的核心。蘇聯方面，紅軍步兵用AK-47與AKM突擊步槍，通用機槍是PKM與車載式PKT，反器材武器用DShK與SPG-9，火箭筒是RPG-7；裝甲車輛有T-62、T-64與八十年代投入戰場的T-72戰車，BTR-60、BTR-70、BRDM-2偵察車、BMD-1空降戰車組成機動力量；砲兵有122與152毫米牽引用榴彈砲及2S1自行砲，防空有9K33與9K37；航空力量是Mi-8與Mi-24武裝直升機、MiG-21與MiG-23戰鬥機、Su-17與Su-22攻擊機、八十年代初投入的Su-25與An-2輕型運輸機，重型空運則靠Il-76，十二月二十四日的空降作戰正是用它把傘兵送到巴格蘭與坎大哈。游擊隊一方是中國製56式步槍與美製M16、手持防空用的針刺與吹管單兵導彈、107毫米火箭砲、大量自造火炮與地雷，車輛則是架上機槍的皮卡車。海上那一面同樣不能略過：太平洋艦隊的基洛夫級核動力戰列巡洋艦與基輔級裝甲航母，正是一八六二年那條線的末端——裝甲帶變成了裝甲飛行甲板；蘇聯情報船維克爾一九八七年在阿拉伯海勘察巴基斯坦查希瑪核電廠，是這條血統的情報版本；巴基斯坦與印度在八十年代後期接收的基洛級潛艇，也出自同一條線。鐵甲艦本身從未到過阿富汗，但它的邏輯決定了誰能看見印度洋。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card, a British ship of 1862, is the beginning of a lineage: wood covered with iron, armour for the first time harder to deal with than guns, so that the design of the turret was thereafter built around the armour. The weapons of this war stand a hundred and seventeen years away from it, yet the formula it established was still at work: armour absorbs the blow, speed decides the position, and the heavy gun strikes at the core of the enemy. On the Soviet side the infantry carried AK-47 and AKM assault rifles, the general-purpose machine guns were the PKM and the vehicle-mounted PKT, the anti-matériel weapons the DShK and the SPG-9, and the rocket launcher the RPG-7. The armoured vehicles included T-62, T-64 and T-72 tanks, with the T-72 entering combat in this war during the 1980s, while the BTR-60, the BTR-70, the BRDM-2 reconnaissance vehicle and the BMD-1 airborne fighting vehicle made up the mobile forces. The artillery comprised 122mm and 152mm towed howitzers and 2S1 self-propelled guns, the air defence the 9K33 and the 9K37, and the air arm the Mi-8 and Mi-24 attack helicopters, the MiG-21 and MiG-23 fighters, the Su-17 and Su-22 attack aircraft, the Su-25 and the An-2 light transport, with the heavy lift given over to the Il-76; the airborne operation of 24 December was carried out in exactly that machine, flying the paratroopers into Bagram and Kandahar. On the mujahideen side were Chinese Type 56 rifles and American M16s, the Stinger and Blowpipe manportable air defence missiles, 107mm rocket launchers, a great many improvised guns and mines, and vehicles that were pickup trucks with machine guns bolted on. The sea face of the war cannot be passed over either: the Kirov-class nuclear-powered battlecruisers and the Kiev-class aircraft carriers of the Pacific Fleet were the far end of the very line that began in 1862, the belt armour having become the armoured flight deck; the Soviet intelligence ship Vekhr surveying the Pakistani nuclear plant at Chashma in the Arabian Sea in 1987 was the intelligence version of that same lineage; and the Kilo-class submarines handed to Pakistan and India in the late 1980s came out of it too. The ironclad itself never reached Afghanistan, but its logic decided who could see the Indian Ocean.
tactics: 一九七九年十二月二十四日清晨，蘇聯以一次教科書式的空降作戰拉開戰幕：第104空降師與第76近衛空突師在巴格蘭、喀布爾國際機場、坎大哈與賈拉勒阿巴德同時著陸，第108摩托化步兵師隨後沿捷詹方向的道路突入，第8近衛聯合軍封鎖各主要城市。傘兵控制機場、封住跑道、迅速擴張，讓後續的Il-76機隊得以把裝備與增援源源不斷送入；二十七日部隊進駐喀布爾市區，二十八日國安部特勤人員在總統府得手，政權在一夜之間換手。此後蘇軍放棄大規模運動戰，改用據點加封鎖：在巴格蘭、坎大哈、賈拉勒阿巴德、法扎巴德與昆都茲等要地建永久性基地，配置地雷場與反戰車壕，組成封鎖線；游擊隊則在公路沿線伏擊縱隊，用地雷與火箭筒消耗護衛，用流動游擊消耗兵力。冬季是蘇軍最難熬的季節，山口積雪令道路癱瘓，游擊隊在薩朗山口一帶重兵截擊，蘇軍只能靠直升機分批突進。Mi-24武裝直升機是這場戰爭的招牌，它把火力與裝甲合二為一，可以低空貼地掃射，而游擊隊缺乏高射砲火，除了針刺單兵防空導彈幾乎沒有辦法。作戰後期蘇軍把突擊交給航空兵與砲兵配合的現代化模式，一九八八年納吉布拉的第7軍在賈拉勒阿巴德與坎大哈方向正是用這種打法收復失地。游擊隊的戰術始終圍繞讓蘇軍自己走進埋伏：技術車隊、供應縱隊與巡邏隊是主要目標，封鎖線越長縱隊越多，縱隊越多伏擊越有利。蘇軍後期改用護衛編隊，每支縱隊配裝甲車、步兵戰車與武裝直升機護航，勝敗仍取決於地形、燃油與道路。
tacticsEn: At dawn on 24 December 1979 the Soviets opened with a textbook airborne operation: the 104th Airborne Division and the 76th Guards Air Assault Division landed simultaneously at Bagram, Kabul International, Kandahar and Jalalabad, the 108th Motor Rifle Division came in over the roads from the Termez direction, and the 8th Guards Combined Arms Army sealed the main towns. The paratroopers took the airfields, closed the runways and spread out fast, which allowed the Il-76 fleet that followed to feed in equipment and reinforcements without pause; on the 27th the troops entered Kabul itself, and on the 28th the security service men who had entered the presidential palace got what they came for, and the government changed hands in a single night. From then on the Soviet army gave up large-scale mobile warfare in favour of bases and cordons: permanent bases were built at Bagram, Kandahar, Jalalabad, Faizabad and Kunduz, laid out with minefields and anti-tank ditches, and tied together into lines of blockade. The mujahideen answered by ambushing convoys along the roads, wearing down the escorts with mines and rocket launchers and wearing down the troops with shifting harassment. Winter was the hardest season for the Soviets, as snow closed the passes and the mujahideen massed to cut the Salang, where the Soviet advance could only be carried in by helicopter in small lifts. The Mi-24 attack helicopter was the signature weapon of the war, combining gun and armour and able to sweep the ground at low level, and the mujahideen had almost no answer to it beyond the Stinger. In the later phase the Soviets shifted to a modern pattern of strikes by aircraft and artillery working together, and in 1988 Najibullah's 7th Corps took back ground at Jalalabad and Kandahar precisely in this way. The mujahideen tactic remained that of making the Soviet army walk into an ambush: technical vehicles, supply convoys and patrols were the targets, the longer the cordon the more convoys there were, and the more convoys there were the better the ambush worked. The Soviets later adopted escorted convoys, with armoured cars, infantry fighting vehicles and attack helicopters guarding each column, and the outcome still turned on the ground, the fuel and the roads.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。戰爭自一九七九年十二月二十四日空降作戰起，到一九八九年二月十五日最後一批蘇聯部隊離境為止，歷時九年零兩個月，地點是阿富汗全境與巴基斯坦西北部白沙瓦一帶的營地。蘇聯兵力峰值約十一萬五千人，戰時先後有六十二萬人經過阿富汗；蘇軍陣亡約一萬五千人，官方公布為一萬五千零五十一人，負傷與重殘者合計數萬人，損失飛機數百架，其中Mi-8與Mi-24是主要損耗型。蘇聯對阿富汗的軍援總額在數十億盧布的量級。阿軍主力在八十年代約四萬至五萬人，另有民兵數十萬；游擊隊作戰人員最高時逾三十萬。據公開估計，援助游擊隊的資金每月約三百萬至六百萬美元，1980年代中期一度更高，其中包括交付的針刺與吹管單兵防空導彈數百具。時間線極為密集：一九七八年四月肖爾革命與隨後的清洗，一九七九年四月至五月阿富汗與巴基斯坦在帕尼希爾地區交火，一九七九年十二月二十四日空降作戰、二十七日進軍首都、二十八日阿明被殺，一九八〇年四月卡爾邁爾出任總統，同年蘇軍部分撤出且美國與七國集團拒絕參加莫斯科奧運，一九八六年布熱津斯基與蘇方代表在日內瓦會面，一九八七年八月十四日在日內瓦簽定協議，一九八九年二月十五日撤軍完成，一九九二年內戰全面爆發。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The war ran from the airborne operation of 24 December 1979 to the departure of the last Soviet troops on 15 February 1989, a space of nine years and two months, fought across the whole of Afghanistan and in the camps around Peshawar in north-western Pakistan. Soviet strength peaked at about one hundred and fifteen thousand men, and some six hundred and twenty thousand servicemen passed through Afghanistan during the war. Soviet military dead were about fifteen thousand, the official figure being fifteen thousand and fifty-one, with tens of thousands more wounded or permanently disabled, and several hundred aircraft lost, the Mi-8 and the Mi-24 being the types that suffered most. The total Soviet military aid to Afghanistan was on the order of several billion rubles. The Afghan regular army numbered roughly forty to fifty thousand men in the 1980s, with tens of thousands more in the militia, while the mujahideen fielded at their peak more than three hundred thousand men. On public estimates the money reaching the mujahideen ran at some three to six million dollars a month, and was higher in the mid-1980s, and it included several hundred Stinger and Blowpipe missiles. The timetable is very crowded: the Saur Revolution and the purges that followed it in April 1978; fighting between Afghan and Pakistani forces in the Panjshir region from April to May 1979; the airborne operation of 24 December 1979, the entry into the capital on the 27th, the killing of Amin on the 28th; Karmal's accession in April 1980, in the same year as the partial Soviet withdrawal and the refusal of the United States and seven other countries to attend the Moscow Olympics; the meeting of Brzezinski with Soviet representatives at Geneva in 1986; the signature at Geneva on 14 August 1987; the completion of the withdrawal on 15 February 1989; and the full outbreak of civil war in 1992.
cause: 導火線是一九七八年四月肖爾革命之後的權力真空。毛拉穆罕默德·塔拉基與人民派推翻親蘇的舊王室之後，掌權的派系互相傾軋：四月二十八日中央委員會書記被秘密處決，同月末以叛國罪名清洗反對派，詩人兼外交部長費茲在名單上，阿克蘭·亞里在政變當日身亡；九月阿卜沙爾營又處決一批書記，獨裁的輪廓於是成形。阿明表面上仍是毛拉式的革命者，實際上逐步以最高領袖自居，蘇聯在肖爾革命時低估了他。真正的國際化轉折發生在一九七九年：阿富汗軍隊在西北部與巴基斯坦接壤的帕尼希爾地區越境作戰，邊境衝突把巴基斯坦軍牽了進來；四月十九日阿軍包圍並襲擊喀布爾的蘇聯大使館，蘇聯隨之中斷了部分武器供應；阿明向美國索求武器，卻發現華盛頓在卡特政府的新政策下已中止對喀布爾的軍援。中亞軍區原本只策劃一場有限軍事行動，最後被國安委員會的安德羅波夫改造成推翻阿明政權的全面介入；布里茲涅夫在開戰前夜還接見阿明，要他靠攏蘇聯，阿明不肯，數日後便被自己宮廷的槍聲埋葬。
causeEn: The trigger was the power vacuum that followed the Saur Revolution of April 1978. After Maulana Muhammad Taraki and the People's faction overthrew the old pro-Soviet monarchy, the factions in power turned on each other: on 28 April the secretaries of the central committee were put to the secret, and by the end of the same month those accused of treason were purged, the poet and foreign minister Faiz among them, while Akram Yari was killed on the very day of the coup; in September the camp at Afshar executed another batch of secretaries, and the outline of a dictatorship was thus completed. On the surface Amin was still the revolutionary of the mullah type, but in practice he was gradually behaving as a supreme leader, and Moscow had underestimated him in the Saur Revolution. The real international turn came in 1979: Afghan forces crossed into the Panjshir region in the north-west where it met Pakistan, and the border fighting pulled the Pakistani army in; on 19 April the Afghan army surrounded and attacked the Soviet embassy in Kabul, and Moscow duly suspended part of its arms deliveries; Amin went to the United States for weapons and found that Washington, under the new policy of the Carter administration, had already stopped arming Kabul. The Turkestan Military District had planned a limited military operation, but the Security Council under Andropov turned it into a full intervention to bring down Amin's government. Brezhnev received Amin on the eve of the war and told him to come closer to the Soviets; Amin would not, and a few days later he was buried by gunfire from his own court.
impact: 這場戰爭是冷戰末段最長的一場代理戰，改變的不只是阿富汗。對蘇聯而言，戰爭成了體制的累贅：外匯被消耗，兵員被拖住，軍隊被西方化的焦慮反過來推動了改革；一九八五年戈巴喬夫上台後，新任總參謀長阿赫羅梅耶夫嘗試以新策略取代正面強攻，用特種作戰、代理游擊隊與少量精銳部隊降低代價，最後仍然簽下了撤軍。對美國而言，代理戰成了可負擔的策略：游擊隊拿到針刺與吹管之後，蘇聯固定翼機與直升機的損失急升，莫斯科在日內瓦與第比利斯的談判中一再退讓；美國也第一次把這類衝突說成由情報機關出資的道德等價戰爭。對巴基斯坦而言，戰爭迫使其情報局深度介入阿富汗，而蘇聯在阿拉伯海的艦隊與後來交付的基洛級潛艇，始終是它頭頂的陰影。戰爭結束後，阿富汗進入內戰與塔利班時代，後果一路延伸到二〇〇一年的戰爭；而蘇聯解體與冷戰終結，則是這場九年消耗最深的回報。
impactEn: This was the longest proxy war of the late Cold War, and what it changed went far beyond Afghanistan. For the Soviet Union the war became a weight on the system: foreign exchange drained, manpower tied up, and the anxiety about the army going western pushed reform in the opposite direction; after Gorbachev took over in 1985 the new chief of the general staff, Akhromeyev, tried to replace frontal assault with a new strategy, using special operations, proxies and small elite formations to cut the cost, and in the end still signed the withdrawal. For the United States the proxy war turned out to be an affordable strategy: once the mujahideen had the Stinger and the Blowpipe, Soviet losses in fixed-wing aircraft and helicopters climbed sharply and Moscow gave way repeatedly in the talks at Geneva and Tbilisi; America had also for the first time described a conflict of this kind as a war of moral equivalence, funded through the intelligence services. For Pakistan the war forced its intelligence service deep into Afghan affairs, and the Soviet fleets in the Arabian Sea and the Kilo-class submarines handed over later remained a shadow overhead. After the war Afghanistan entered the era of civil war and the Taliban, consequences that ran all the way to the fighting of 2001; and the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the end of the Cold War were the deepest return on nine years of expenditure.
result: 軍事上，蘇聯在最初十天就贏得了所有看得見的目標：空降兵控制四座機場，部隊進駐首都，阿明被殺，卡爾邁爾在喀布爾組成新政府，蘇聯扶持的政權在形式上維持了九年。但戰略上蘇聯始終沒有解決兩個問題：怎樣把游擊隊從山裡趕出來，以及怎樣在不失去阿富汗的情況下讓山裡的人放棄抵抗。封鎖線越拉越長，縱隊越走越慢，燃料與彈藥的開支越滾越大；游擊隊從一開始的數千人變成數十萬人，並且在巴基斯坦與伊朗建立了穩定的後方。到一九八七年，蘇聯內部已在討論放棄部分阿富汗領土的代價，一九八八年上半年開始小規模撤出，一九八九年二月十五日最後一批部隊與大使館人員離開喀布爾，經喀什返回塔吉克斯坦。結果是蘇聯用九年的戰爭換來九年的絕望：不流血地失去一個親蘇的首都；阿富汗則用九年的戰爭換來一個破碎的國家、一支帶著美制武器與聖戰經驗的隊伍，以及一九九二年之後全面展開的內戰。
resultEn: Militarily the Soviets won every visible objective in the first ten days: the airborne troops held four airfields, the troops entered the capital, Amin was killed, Karmal formed a new government in Kabul, and the Soviet-backed regime survived in form for nine years. Strategically, however, the Soviets never solved two problems: how to drive the mujahideen out of the mountains, and how to make the men in the mountains give up resistance without losing Afghanistan. The cordon grew longer, the convoys grew slower, and the bill for fuel and ammunition grew with them; the mujahideen went from a few thousand men to tens of thousands, and built a stable rear area in Pakistan and Iran. By 1987 the Soviet leadership was already discussing the price of giving up part of Afghan territory, small withdrawals began in the first half of 1988, and on 15 February 1989 the last troops and the embassy staff left Kabul to return to Tajikistan through Kashgar. The result was that the Soviet Union bought nine years of despair with nine years of war, and lost a pro-Soviet capital without a shot; and Afghanistan bought a shattered state, an army carrying American weapons and the experience of a holy war, and the civil war that broke out in full after 1992.
